quotes/augustine-church-now-kingdom/text: Therefore the Church even now is the kingdom of Christ, and the kingdom of heaven.
quotes/joachim-three-status/text: Joachim taught that history unfolds in three states (status): the age of the Father under the law, lived by the married; the age of the Son under grace, lived by the clergy; and a coming age of the Holy Spirit, of fuller spiritual understanding and contemplative liberty, lived by monks.
quotes/muntzer-sword-against-godless/tex: Müntzer told the Saxon princes that the stone "cut without hands" of Daniel 2 was about to crush the kingdoms of the world, and that if the princes would not use their sword to root out the godless, it would be taken from them.
quotes/augsburg-jewish-opinions/text: They condemn also others who are now spreading certain Jewish opinions, that before the resurrection of the dead the godly shall take possession of the kingdom of the world, the ungodly being everywhere suppressed.
quotes/calvin-chiliasts-puerile/text: Shortly after arose the Chiliasts, who limited the reign of Christ to a thousand years. Now their fiction is too puerile to need or to deserve refutation.
quotes/edwards-glorious-success/text: Edwards argued that through successive outpourings of the Spirit the gospel would spread over the whole earth, overthrowing Satan’s kingdoms (which he identified with heathenism, Islam and the papacy), so that a long era of peace, learning and holiness would precede Christ’s final return.
quotes/miller-twenty-five-years/text: I was thus brought, in 1818, at the close of my two years’ study of the Scriptures, to the solemn conclusion, that in about twenty-five years from that time all the affairs of our present state would be wound up.
quotes/darby-heavenly-people/text: Darby taught that the Church is a heavenly people with a heavenly calling, distinct from Israel, God’s earthly people; the prophecies of an earthly kingdom belong to Israel, and the Church’s proper hope is to be caught up to meet Christ before God resumes his dealings with Israel.
quotes/scofield-dispensation-definition/: A dispensation is a period of time during which man is tested in respect of obedience to some specific revelation of the will of God. Seven such dispensations are distinguished in Scripture.
quotes/dodd-kingdom-has-come/text: Dodd argued that in Jesus’ preaching the kingdom of God is not a future hope but a present fact: the eschaton has entered history in the ministry, death and resurrection of Jesus, and the parables summon hearers to decide in that moment of crisis.
quotes/ladd-already-not-yet/text: Ladd argued that the kingdom of God is God’s dynamic reign, which has invaded this age in Jesus without yet ending it: the age to come has arrived in fulfilment before its consummation, so believers live "between the times".
quotes/tertullian-unbelted-every-soldier: But how will a Christian man war, nay, how will he serve even in peace, without a sword, which the Lord has taken away? ... the Lord afterward, in disarming Peter, unbelted every soldier.
quotes/origen-army-of-piety/text: And none fight better for the king than we do. We do not indeed fight under him, although he require it; but we fight on his behalf, forming a special army, an army of piety, by offering our prayers to God.
quotes/eusebius-conquer-by-this/text: He saw with his own eyes the trophy of a cross of light in the heavens, above the sun, and bearing the inscription, Conquer by this.
quotes/augustine-real-evils-in-war/text: The real evils in war are love of violence, revengeful cruelty, fierce and implacable enmity, wild resistance, and the lust of power, and such like.
quotes/augustine-two-loves-two-cities/te: Accordingly, two cities have been formed by two loves: the earthly by the love of self, even to the contempt of God; the heavenly by the love of God, even to the contempt of self.
quotes/gelasius-two-there-are/text: Two there are, august emperor, by which this world is chiefly ruled, namely, the sacred authority of the priests and the royal power.
quotes/aquinas-three-things-just-war/tex: In order for a war to be just, three things are necessary. First, the authority of the sovereign by whose command the war is to be waged. ... Secondly, a just cause is required ... Thirdly, it is necessary that the belligerents should have a rightful intention, so that they intend the advancement of good, or the avoidance of evil.
quotes/luther-two-governments/text: Luther argued that God has ordained two governments: the spiritual, by which the Holy Spirit makes Christians righteous through the Word, and the temporal, which restrains the wicked with the sword. True Christians need no sword among themselves, but because the world is full of the unrighteous, they willingly serve and submit to the sword for the sake of their neighbours.
quotes/schleitheim-sword-outside-perfect: The Schleitheim brethren agreed that the sword is ordained by God but "outside the perfection of Christ": magistrates rightly use it to punish the wicked, but within the church only the ban is used, and Christians should not serve as magistrates, since Christ refused to be made king and his followers are citizens of heaven.
quotes/augsburg-just-wars/text: Of Civil Affairs they teach that lawful civil ordinances are good works of God, and that it is right for Christians to bear civil office, to sit as judges, to judge matters by the Imperial and other existing laws, to award just punishments, to engage in just wars, to serve as soldiers ... They condemn the Anabaptists who forbid these civil offices to Christians.
quotes/quaker-deny-outward-wars/text: We utterly deny all outward wars and strife and fightings with outward weapons, for any end or under any pretense whatsoever; and this is our testimony to the whole world.
quotes/las-casas-destruction-indies/text: Las Casas, a former encomendero turned Dominican friar, testified that the Spanish conquerors had killed and enslaved the peoples of the Indies with unspeakable cruelty for the sake of gold, and argued that the indigenous peoples were rational, free human beings who could be brought to Christ only by peaceful persuasion, never by war.
quotes/stringfellow-slavery-sanctioned/t: Stringfellow argued that slavery had been sanctioned by God in the patriarchal age, incorporated into the Mosaic law, left uncondemned by Jesus and regulated rather than abolished by the apostles, so that abolitionism contradicted Scripture. These arguments are recorded here as historical evidence of how Scripture was used to defend slavery; they have since been repudiated by virtually all Christian traditions.
quotes/douglass-christianity-of-christ/t: I love the pure, peaceable, and impartial Christianity of Christ; I therefore hate the corrupt, slaveholding, women-whipping, cradle-plundering, partial and hypocritical Christianity of this land.
quotes/rauschenbusch-social-gospel-theol: We have a social gospel. We need a systematic theology large enough to match it and vital enough to back it.
quotes/rauschenbusch-social-crisis-para/: Rauschenbusch argued that the essential purpose of Christianity is to transform human society into the kingdom of God by regenerating all human relations, and that the Church had lost this prophetic social vision of the Hebrew prophets and Jesus.
quotes/barmen-one-word-of-god/text: The first Barmen thesis confesses Jesus Christ, as attested in Scripture, as the one Word of God whom the Church must hear, trust and obey in life and death, and rejects the false teaching that the Church could recognise other events, powers, figures or truths besides this one Word as sources of its proclamation.
quotes/gutierrez-preferential-option/tex: Gutiérrez argued that theology is a critical reflection on Christian practice in the light of God’s Word, and that because God’s love is universal yet shows preference for the poor and oppressed, the Church must commit itself to their liberation from unjust social structures, seen as part of the one process of salvation.
quotes/king-unjust-law/text: King argued, following Augustine and Aquinas, that an unjust law is no law at all: a law out of harmony with the moral law of God degrades human personality, and one who breaks it openly, lovingly and willingly accepting the penalty shows the highest respect for law.
quotes/irenaeus-prophetic-gifts/text: In like manner we do also hear many brethren in the Church, who possess prophetic gifts, and who through the Spirit speak all kinds of languages, and bring to light for the general benefit the hidden things of men, and declare the mysteries of God.
quotes/montanus-lyre-plectrum/text: In an oracle preserved by Epiphanius, the Spirit speaking through Montanus says that a human being is like a lyre and the Spirit like the plectrum that strikes it: the man sleeps while the Spirit keeps watch.
quotes/eusebius-anonymous-montanus-frenz: He became beside himself, and being suddenly in a sort of frenzy and ecstasy, he raved, and began to babble and utter strange things, prophesying in a manner contrary to the constant custom of the Church handed down by tradition from the beginning.
quotes/tertullian-put-to-flight-paraclet: Praxeas did a twofold service for the devil at Rome: he drove away prophecy, and he brought in heresy; he put to flight the Paraclete, and he crucified the Father.
quotes/basil-restoration-to-paradise/tex: Through the Holy Spirit comes our restoration to paradise, our ascension into the kingdom of heaven, our return to the adoption of sons.
quotes/chrysostom-cessation-of-facts/tex: This whole place is very obscure: but the obscurity is produced by our ignorance of the facts referred to and by their cessation, being such as then used to occur but now no longer take place.
quotes/augustine-signs-adapted-to-time/t: In the earliest times, the Holy Ghost fell upon them that believed: and they spake with tongues, which they had not learned, as the Spirit gave them utterance. These were signs adapted to the time.
quotes/augustine-miracles-even-now/text: For even now miracles are wrought in the name of Christ, whether by His sacraments or by the prayers or relics of His saints.
quotes/wesley-love-waxed-cold/text: The real cause was, "the love of many," almost of all Christians, so called, was "waxed cold."
quotes/warfield-authentication-apostles/: These gifts were not the possession of the primitive Christian as such; nor for that matter of the Apostolic Church or the Apostolic age for themselves; they were distinctively the authentication of the Apostles.
quotes/seymour-pentecost-has-come/text: Pentecost Has Come: Los Angeles Being Visited by a Revival of Bible Salvation and Pentecost as Recorded in the Book of Acts
quotes/parham-bible-evidence/text: Parham taught his Topeka students that speaking in tongues was the biblical evidence of the baptism in the Holy Spirit, and at first believed the tongues would be real foreign languages that would let missionaries preach without learning them.
quotes/wimber-power-evangelism-para/text: Wimber argued that the gospel advances most powerfully when proclamation is accompanied by demonstrations of God’s power, such as healing and deliverance, which break down resistance and reveal that the kingdom of God has arrived.
quotes/wagner-second-apostolic-age/text: Wagner claimed that around 2001 the Church entered a "Second Apostolic Age", in which recognised apostles and prophets once again govern networks of churches and give strategic direction for transforming society.
